onset.Description: Event onset relative to the first stored sample in the corresponding MEG recording.

duration.Description: Event duration measured from onset. Stimulus events use the 0.5-second presentation duration specified by the experimental protocol; button responses are instantaneous.

Levels.response: Button-response marker recorded by the MEG system.

trial_type.Description: Experimental condition; n/a for response events. Each stimulus presented two words drawn from three categories: death-related, life-related, and neutral. Congruent trials placed the probe at the location of the death- or life-related target word; incongruent trials placed the probe at the location of the accompanying neutral word. Neutral trials presented two neutral words.

Levels.DC: A death-related word and a neutral word were presented, and the probe appeared at the location of the death-related word.
Levels.DI: A death-related word and a neutral word were presented, and the probe appeared at the location of the neutral word.
Levels.LC: A life-related word and a neutral word were presented, and the probe appeared at the location of the life-related word.
Levels.LI: A life-related word and a neutral word were presented, and the probe appeared at the location of the neutral word.
Levels.unknown_condition: Stimulus onset without a corresponding condition marker in the MEG trigger data.

response.Description: Recorded button response; n/a for stimulus events.

value.Description: Integer value from the source MEG trigger export. Values must be interpreted together with event_type, trial_type, and response because encoding can vary by subject.

sample.Description: Sample index corresponding to the event onset in the MEG recording.
